_comment: Row Z-heights in mm (metersPerUnit=0.001). Originally extracted from the now-removed SM_Skandi-Seats.usd by clustering chair Z positions into 40 row levels and scaling x10 from cm to mm. Persisted as data because the source asset is gone — edit by hand if rows ever need re-tuning. Row 0 = innermost/lowest, row 39 = outermost/highest. WC = wheelchair, same level as row 6.
